stem:
A swimming pool is in the shape of a cylinder:

• The diameter of the swimming pool is 15 feet.

• The height of the swimming pool is 4.5 feet.

Complete the equation that represents V, the volume of the swimming pool in cubic feet.
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
notes: Standard formula for volume of a cylinder is V=πr²h, where radius = diameter/2 = 7.5 and height = 4.5. Choices reflect these numbers and squares.
